_doc: Analysis grids (PLAN.md 5.1). kind=cap: H3 cells with centre latitude <= lat_max_deg. kind=patch: cells whose centre lies in a square of half-size half_size_km, axis-aligned in the south polar stereographic plane, centred on center_lat_deg/center_lon_deg (east-positive longitude).

shackleton_ridge.source: IAU/USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, feature 5450 'Shackleton' (Moon, crater, diameter 20.92 km): centre latitude -89.67, centre longitude 129.78 (+East, -180 to 180), first coordinate set listed on the page. https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/5450 , retrieved 2026-11-14.
